race.comment: AFFAIRE DE COVER (10) is working towards a win. Turned in a good run here last time out when third from a 20m handicap. Has to contend with a very wide draw but is a big chance with even luck. ONE PINEVALE HILL (7) was let down by manners last time but looks suited returning to a mobile start having come from this barrier for a 6m win two back at this circuit and distance. MOJITO MADNESS (8) showed good improvement in finishing runner-up at Goulburn last time out and could progress further third up. CASUALCONNECTION (4) got it wrong last start but has claims off a good second here prior.
